description: Canonical version stamp of the forVEX horizontal skill + MCP interaction contract. This is the single source of truth. Downstream repos MIRROR this value (reference it and keep it in sync); they MUST NOT redefine it locally or let a local copy diverge. See reecosystem-core/docs/AGENT_CONVENTIONS.md (cross-repo change protocol).
breakingChanges: forvex_underwrite no longer returns verdict, best_strategy, best_deal_score, per-strategy deal_score or the recommendation_* envelope; it returns status (READY / VERIFY_ARV) and the strategy matrix.
exit_strategy is owned by the operator (forvex_set_exit_strategy / readvise API) with provenance fields; forvex_save_deal no longer derives it from the analysis.
Buy box gains primary_exits (ordered list) and other_monthly_default; forvex_underwrite gains other_monthly, other_monthly_label, utilities_monthly.
